ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate the central and basal areas, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along the splashing water boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous black pigmentation across approx. 92% of the visible surface; discrete white rosette-pattern clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes, with several vertical white linear streaks mapped to the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approx. 50-degree V-shaped central depression, with the apex vertex partially occluded by high-intensity white-water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe boundary shows high-amplitude, irregular macro-voids (large missing chunks); the right lobe boundary exhibits a series of low-amplitude, high-frequency sawtooth serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe displays a consistent concave upward sweep; the left lobe displays a discontinuous, jagged trajectory resulting from significant tissue loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters with roughly circular geometry located at the extreme distal points of the right lobe and along the fragmented edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct near-vertical high-contrast white lines (rake marks) situated on the mid-lateral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe, irregular tissue loss and multiple deep indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating significant physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme asymmetry between the relatively preserved right lobe trailing edge and the heavily mutilated left lobe trailing edge.
